macros.name: linesyscircled
macros.doc: The package also defines \linesyscircled as the command used by the built-in pivot highlighter. It takes one argument and places that argument inside a TikZ circle; this command is available independently of the environment.

macros.name: linesysdeclaretransparentwrapper
macros.doc: Declare a one-argument source form \foo{content} transparent to lexical coefficient classification.

macros.name: linesyssetcommonoptions
macros.doc: Set only the persistent options shared by both renderers.

macros.name: linesyswrapdisable
macros.doc: Suppress visual wrapper application within the surrounding TeX group; wrapper syntax is still parsed and validated.

macros.name: linesyswrapenable
macros.doc: Re-enable visual wrapper application within the surrounding TeX group.

macros.name: linexpsetdefaultoptions
macros.doc: Set persistent defaults for linexp and \linexpr .

envs.name: linesys
envs.doc: The linesys environment turns an augmented matrix into a system of linear equations or inequalities, while linexp turns one coefficient row into a linear expression.

envs.name: linexp
envs.doc: The linexp environment typesets one linear expression from one row of coefficients.
